svg.title: Evidence-driven debugging loop
svg.desc: An observed failure leads to a minimal reproducer, a reference-model hypothesis, a discriminating experiment, a repair to the cause, and a regression test. Contradictory evidence returns the debugger to a revised hypothesis.
